The PR changes `NodeExecutionEnv` file metadata to derive `FileInfo.name` with Windows-aware basename splitting and adds a regression test for Windows-style paths.

PR surface: Source +6, Tests +48. Total +54 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main still derives `FileInfo.name` by trimming and splitting only POSIX separators, so a Windows path can retain parent directories despite the basename contract. I did not run a before-fix Windows runtime repro in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(agent-core): keep file info basename on Windows paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users inspecting files through the agent harness on Windows would see `FileInfo.name` include parent directories when the addressed path used Windows separators.

## Why This Change Was Made

`FileInfo.name` should be the display basename for both POSIX and Windows addressed paths, while `FileInfo.path` should keep the resolved addressed path for callers that need the full location.

## User Impact

Windows harness file metadata now reports stable basename-only names, so callers can display or compare file entries without carrying the full parent path in `name`.

## Evidence

- Current head: `37f8af0b070b89844c1bcb7ba798e138fe2f341c`, after merge with `upstream/main` at `b8cdb93f6ffa46f689a9ed799d9543e38228bd44`.
- Claim proved: Windows-style addressed paths now produce basename-only `FileInfo.name` values through `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo()` while preserving the addressed path.
- Current-head focused test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/env/nodejs.test.ts` passed with `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`, and `[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 53.89s`.
- Current-head diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Real Windows runtime proof at `37f8af0b070b89844c1bcb7ba798e138fe2f341c`: a Node runtime command created a temporary file, called `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo()` on its Windows-addressed backslash path, redacted the repo prefix, and removed the file. It produced:

```json
{
  "platform": "win32",
  "inputPath": "<repo>\\.agents\\tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783606880938.txt",
  "expectedName": "tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783606880938.txt",
  "observedName": "tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783606880938.txt",
  "basenameOnly": true,
  "pathPreserved": true,
  "result": {
    "ok": true,
    "value": {
      "name": "tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783606880938.txt",
      "path": "<repo>\\.agents\\tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783606880938.txt",
      "kind": "file",
      "size": 5
    }
  }
}
```

- Observed result: the shared `fileInfoFromStats` path reports a basename-only `name` for Windows separators and keeps the original addressed path in `path`.
